breadcrumb: Std 9 Social Science (English) — Civics Unit 1: Forms of Government and Democracy — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: According to Mahatma Gandhi, 'True democracy cannot be worked by twenty men sitting at the centre. It has to be worked from below by the people of every village.'

en.q: According to Mahatma Gandhi, true democracy has to be worked:
options: from below by the people of every village
by twenty men sitting at the centre

ta.q: மகாத்மா காந்தியின் கூற்றுப்படி உண்மையான மக்களாட்சி எவ்வாறு செயல்பட வேண்டும்?

questions.quote: General elections in British India in 1920 to elect members to the Imperial Legislative Council and the Provincial Councils were the first elections in the country's history. Women got the right to vote in 1921, when the general election was held in the Madras presidency.

en.q: Women got the right to vote in 1921 in which presidency of British India?
en.explanation: The 1920 elections were the first in the country's history.

questions.quote: Challenges to democracy: illiteracy, poverty, gender discrimination, regionalism, casteism, communalism and religious fundamentalism, corruption, criminalisation of politics, political violence.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT listed in the textbook as a challenge to Indian democracy?
en.explanation: Universal adult franchise is a feature, not a challenge.

ta.q: இந்திய மக்களாட்சிக்கு சவால்களாகப் பாடநூல் குறிப்பிடாதது எது?
ta.explanation: உலகளாவிய வாக்குரிமை சவால் அல்ல, ஒரு சிறப்புக்கூறு.

questions.quote: Conditions for the success of democracy: empowerment of the poor and illiterates; an impartial and efficient press; strong public opinion; tolerance and communal harmony; awareness of fundamental rights; vigilance on elected representatives; powerful and responsible opposition.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT a condition for the success of democracy in India?
en.explanation: An impartial and efficient press is needed to form public opinion.

ta.q: இந்தியாவில் மக்களாட்சி வெற்றி பெறத் தேவையான நிபந்தனை அல்லாதது எது?
ta.explanation: பொதுக் கருத்தை உருவாக்க நடுநிலை ஊடகம் தேவை.
